nodes.osada_plotka.text.t: "The Burnt Settlement, two days north." Halina folds her hands. "A village that hid a smith. The soldiers didn't ask, they just burned. We dug the village a grave, but not everyone got buried."

nodes.powitanie.options.[osada_plotka].t.t: Have you heard about the Burnt Settlement?

nodes.powitanie.options.[q12_halina].tex.t: I heard a voice from the stones in the graveyard.

nodes.powitanie.options.[q3_list].text.t: Jerzy the digger asked if you'd read this letter.

nodes.powitanie.options.[q6_start].text.t: Can a man get sealing wax here?

nodes.powitanie.options.[waha].text.t: I don't know what to do now.

nodes.powitanie.text.t: Sister Halina is sweeping the shrine with an old broom. "God takes in everyone, but the sweeping's mine. What blew you in? And don't say chance. Nobody ends up here by chance."

nodes.q12_halina.text.t: Halina sets the broom aside and looks at the shrine a long while, as if seeking a sign. "A voice from the stones. The old folk said that after a spark storm such stones turn up on the graves of those who shouldn't have died. It's no angel and no devil, but some third thing the Church knows nothing of. Want good advice? Leave before the scouts find the hut you sleep in. Don't want advice? Leave anyway. Two days north is Starwatch on Glass Hill. Hieronim the stargazer has spent thirty years there counting what fell from the sky. If anyone can tell you what those stones say, it's him or his cat."

nodes.q3_list.text.t: Halina breaks the seal with her thumb, as if she did it every day, and reads under her breath. "This isn't a letter to anyone. It's an order: 'All survivors of the tribute party are to be detained and questioned in Beckby. Alive.' The signature can't be read. I'll tell you one thing: they want them alive only for the questioning. After that, nobody walks out of there." She rolls up the sheet and tucks it under her habit without looking you in the eye.

nodes.q6_start.text.t: Halina looks at you for a long while. "Sealing wax. So you want papers that don't exist. I won't ask what for, because I know. I'll give the wax, only not to you. To Bogdan the smith, who makes the best signets hereabouts. Take him this wax and tell him it's from the sister. He'll see to the rest."

nodes.waha.text.t: Halina sets the broom aside. "You're wavering because there are no good roads at a crossroads, only less bad ones. Wavering's no sin. The sin is pretending there's no choice. Come back when you know what you're choosing between."
